description: Single-layer per-head first-layer diagnostic (Printables 252059 'Perfect First Layer Test', scaled X/Y to ~250mm). Slow first layer, no brim/skirt, no elephant-foot compensation, so every head is judged on identical gcode. Print one head at a time; the head that prints it is also the head that homes Z and probes the mesh.
name: All Test First Layer @0.4 (ai)
